name: Youkai Wecchi ~Echichi na Oni Da you~
original_name: 妖怪ゑッチ～エチチな鬼だよう～
source:
Aoran, a new student from the countryside, remembers that he forgot something while playing with his friends after school one day.

Aoki, who is a novice by nature unlike his burly appearance, is afraid to go to school at night and rushes back to his classroom to retrieve it.

As he is about to leave, he hears a suspicious sound in the hallway.

It was a ghost story he had heard when he first moved to the school: "In the middle of the night, you can hear the sound of something being piped, and if you hear it, you will die."

Aoki is so terrified that he has to urinate and runs to the school toilet.

There, he found his classmate, Kororo, is sitting in front of the men's toilet and licking the toilet, which was so long that it could not even be compared to a human being.

She then attacks him to get him silent about her being a "kurayame," a monster. Then, Hana, who came out of the private toilet room, yelling and leaning, also revealed herself as "Hanako-san, the flower girl of the toilet."
translation:
奥然是一名来自农村的新生，他记得有一天放学后和朋友们玩耍时忘记了一件事情。

与外表魁梧不同，生性是新手的青木晚上不敢去学校，赶紧跑回教室去取。

正当他准备离开时，走廊里传来一阵可疑的声音。

这是他刚搬到学校时听过的一个鬼故事：“半夜里，你能听到有什么东西在吹笛子的声音，如果你听到它，你就会死。”

青木吓得小便，跑到学校厕所。

在那里，他发现他的同学克罗罗正坐在男厕所前舔着马桶，马桶太长了，连人都比不上。

然后她攻击他，让他对她是“kurayame”（一个怪物）保持沉默。然后，从包间厕所里出来，大喊大叫、倾身而出的花也自曝“厕所花童花子小姐”。
